user_story: As a user, I want to assign a category to a task so that I can organize my tasks.

positive.title: Assign a valid category to a task successfully
steps: Navigate to the task management system.
Select a task from the task list.
Choose a valid category from the category list.
positive.expected_result: The task is updated with the selected category successfully.

negative.title: Attempt to assign a non-existent category to a task
steps: Navigate to the task management system.
Select a task from the task list.
Try to input a non-existent category name.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the category does not exist, and the task category is not updated.

edge.title: Assign a category when there are no available categories
steps: Navigate to the task management system.
Select a task from the task list.
edge.expected_result: The category list is empty or an informative message is displayed, preventing the assignment, with the task remaining uncategorized.
